scope: Implementation details fixed before reading return summaries; complements, does not replace original contract
fold_purge: For each feature audit period keep trades entered in that period only when natural exit also occurred strictly before its end; report removed cross-boundary labels. No feature thresholds fitted.
month_adjusted_effect: Also report harmonic-count-weighted difference between feature groups within same entry month; exploratory market-timing confounding check, no causal identification.
censoring_sensitivity: Natural exits remain primary. Report full-period feature mean differences including endpoint valuation labels separately to expose terminal-censoring sensitivity.
